info.title: Mock Trader API
info.summary: HTTP and WebSocket market data API for the Mock Trader backend.
info.description: Public backend surface for Mock Trader. Paytm authentication and token exchange stay behind the backend and are not exposed as public HTTP endpoints. This document covers the implemented REST endpoints and the market data WebSocket contract.

get.summary: Upgrade to the market data WebSocket
get.description: Initiates an HTTP upgrade to a WebSocket connection for live quote streaming. OpenAPI does not natively model WebSocket channels, so the detailed message contract is described with vendor extensions on this operation.

notes: Clients receive a `connected` event immediately after the socket opens.
Message payloads must be valid JSON encoded as text or binary UTF-8.
Unknown message types produce an `error` message.
Subscription preferences are deduplicated by `instrumentKey` plus `modeType`.
The server enforces a maximum number of active subscriptions per client.

InstrumentId.name: id
InstrumentId.description: Instrument key, security id, or symbol.

InstrumentLimit.name: limit
InstrumentLimit.description: Maximum number of records to return. Defaults to 20 when omitted or invalid.

InstrumentExchange.name: exchange
InstrumentExchange.description: Optional exchange filter, for example `NSE` or `BSE`.

InstrumentScripType.name: scripType
InstrumentScripType.description: Optional scrip type filter, for example `EQUITY`, `INDEX`, `ETF`, `FUTURE`, or `OPTION`.

QuoteIds.name: ids
QuoteIds.description: Comma-separated list of instrument keys, security ids, or symbols.

QuoteMode.name: mode
QuoteMode.description: Requested quote detail level. Invalid values fall back to the configured upstream mode.

CandleInterval.name: interval
CandleInterval.description: Candle interval. Supported by the implementation: `1m`, `5m`, `15m`, `1h`, and `1d`. Unknown values fall back to 1 minute aggregation.

CandleFrom.name: from
CandleFrom.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 start timestamp. Defaults to 6 hours before the request time when omitted or invalid.

CandleTo.name: to
CandleTo.description: Inclusive ISO-8601 end timestamp. Defaults to the request time when omitted or invalid.

CandleLimit.name: limit
CandleLimit.description: Maximum number of 1-minute base candles to load before optional server-side aggregation. Defaults to 1000 when omitted or invalid.

providerTs.description: Provider timestamp in Unix milliseconds when available.

lastUpdatedAt.description: Last update timestamp in Unix milliseconds.

ProviderChartResponse.description: Opaque upstream chart payload forwarded from the provider.

SocketClientSymbolSelector.description: A single subscription selector. The server accepts multiple selector styles and resolves them to a normalized subscription preference.
